sark.title: Flag of Sark

countryData.name: Sark
countryData.officialName: Sark (Crown Dependency under Bailiwick of Guernsey)

colors.note: The Cross of St George with the Norman lions.

desc:
- The flag of Sark features a white field with a red Cross of St George (the English cross), defaced by two golden Norman lions passant in the upper-hoist canton
- Adopted on 16 November 1938, the flag reflects Sark's status as a Crown dependency within the Bailiwick of Guernsey
- The Norman lions recall the Channel Islands' historical ties to the Duchy of Normandy
- **Construction:** a white field with a red cross extending to all edges (Cross of St George)
- Two golden lions passant in the upper-hoist quarter
- Ratio 3:5
trivia:
- Sark is a British Crown dependency in the Channel Islands
- Has its own distinct flag and feudal governance system
- One of the last feudal territories in Europe
